title: Astronomical True Solar Time & Equation of Time Specification for Sexagenary (BaZi) Chronology
description:
Open reference specification, mathematical formulas, and empirical study index for calibrating civil clock timestamps to Astronomical True Solar Time (Apparent Solar Time) in classical Chinese sexagenary (Four Pillars / BaZi) chronology.

Covers longitudinal meridian offset correction, orbital eccentricity and axial obliquity (Equation of Time), exact 15-degree solar ecliptic longitude boundaries (24 Solar Terms / JieQi), Hidden Stems (Cang Gan) reference matrices, and 63 indexed empirical case studies maintained at https://www.bazilens.com.
